facts.claim: The Yfrjijpet School collapsed in 1842 and the teacher’s pay was appropriated for the maintenance of five Canarese Schools.
facts.quote: The Yfrjijpet School collapsed in 1842 and the teacher’s pay was appropriated for the mainten- ance of five Canarese Schools.

facts.claim: After 20 years of English tuition, there was not one Coorg who could write an English letter or make a tolerable translation from Canarese into English.
